:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-oinf .solution}

Negating the [second derivative](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-second-derivative) from @sol-prac-exp-mle-second-derivative
gives the [observed information](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-oinf):

$$
I(\pmean; \vx) = -\hess(\pmean; \vx)
= \frac{2n\bar{x}}{\pmean^3} - \frac{n}{\pmean^2}
$$

:::
